editorial.description_en: A shadow with the sun low behind it. The only violet in the corpus, and it is a violet mainly by measurement.
editorial.description_ja: 冬の低い日ざしがつくる影のような、紫みの灰色。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.420, C 0.046, h 282.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 冬 (fuyu, winter) + 影 (kage, shadow). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Winter Shadow" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 冬影. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — yoru-giri at ΔE00 7.8, samu-boshi at ΔE00 8.3, tetsu-suna at ΔE00 11.1. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (102°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
